description: Structural literature gaps separated from codable literature payloads.

entries.why_literature_cannot_close_it: No benchmark-eligible paper reports intact aqueous SPI or PPI plus cysteine and ribose with absolute MFT and FFT quantification.
entries.cheapest_next_step: Run the primary wet-lab benchmark protocol already defined in the repo.
entries.computational_fallback: None authoritative; keep mechanistic and reference-anchor separation explicit.

entries.why_literature_cannot_close_it: PPI and SPI pyrazine studies in the SLR provide relative areas, OAVs, or non-matrix analogues rather than absolute internal-standard quantitation.
entries.cheapest_next_step: Add pyrazines to the same GC-MS internal-standard panel as the primary benchmark experiment.
entries.computational_fallback: Use directional pH and sugar-family constraints only.

entries.why_literature_cannot_close_it: HEMF and DMHF are mechanistically supported but not measured in PPI or SPI ribose systems.
entries.cheapest_next_step: Add HEMF and DMHF to the primary benchmark analytical panel.
entries.computational_fallback: Mechanistic-only expectation via Blank and Fay 1996 without numeric scoring.

entries.why_literature_cannot_close_it: Acrylamide kinetics are available in free systems and dry matrices, not in aqueous SPI or PPI benchmark-like conditions.
entries.cheapest_next_step: Measure a small T and t design in wet SPI and PPI with acrylamide and free asparagine.
entries.computational_fallback: Keep Knol-based kinetics with matrix-aware reporting caveats.

entries.why_literature_cannot_close_it: No open study simultaneously measures free SH, free amino groups, and denaturation in the same non-hydrolyzed PPI or SPI thermal experiment.
entries.cheapest_next_step: Run a compact process-state calibration experiment with Ellman, OPA, and DSC or equivalent.
entries.computational_fallback: Continue using mixed-anchor transfers with explicit provenance tiers.
